outcome: Give hospital coo / chief medical information officer a governed method to improve coding query resolution time using encounter notes, diagnosis terminology and coding rules, with final decisions…
overview: Clinical Coding Documentation Quality Review addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in healthcare providers operations. The first proof of value uses encounter notes, diagnosis terminology and coding rules. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is coding query resolution time, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: encounter notes, diagnosis terminology and coding rules; define coding query resolution time and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Hospital COO / Chief Medical Information Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for coding query resolution time
